title: cargo
description: Runs the cargo command of a target that @convesoft/nx-rust infers, in the root folder of the Cargo workspace.

features.description: Features to activate, passed as --features. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run, napi-build, wasm-build and doc.

allFeatures.description: Activate all features, passed as --all-features. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run, napi-build, wasm-build and doc.

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default features, passed as --no-default-features. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run, napi-build, wasm-build and doc.

profile.description: The Cargo profile to build with, passed as --profile. Taken by build, check, lint, test, bench, run, napi-build, wasm-build and doc.

targetTriple.description: The platform triple to build for, passed as --target. Taken by build, check, lint, bench, run and doc; test and napi-build run and build for the host triple only, and wasm-build for wasm32-unknown-unknown.

allTargets.description: Check the tests, benches and examples too, passed as --all-targets. Taken by check and lint, where the inferred target sets it.

noDeps.description: Document the workspace's members only, passed as --no-deps. Taken by doc, where the inferred target sets it.

wasmTarget.description: The wasm target of the wasm package, passed to the wasm-bindgen CLI as --target. Taken by wasm-build, where the inferred target sets bundler.

test.description: The test target to run alone, passed as --test to cargo test and cargo nextest run: a name, or a glob pattern that cargo matches. Taken by test.

affectedTests.description: Whether test selects affected tests in a workspace that uses selection. Taken by test.

pluginVersion.description: The plugin's version, which the plugin sets for the cache key. Not meant to be set by hand.
